map.不。大克拉稀缺，单价随重量指数上升；同等级 1ct 单价远高于 0.9ct，整克: No. Large carats are scarce, so unit price rises exponentially with weight; a 1ct of the same grade costs far more than 0.9ct, and whole carats are price jump points.
map.克拉重量越接近整数越贵？: Is a weight closer to a whole number more expensive?
map.是，存在「克拉溢价 / 临界重量」现象：0.99 ct 与 1.00 ct 肉眼: Yes, there is a 'carat premium / critical weight' effect: 0.99 ct and 1.00 ct look almost identical to the naked eye, yet the price often jumps 10–30% because 1 ct is a key psychological threshold; the same steps occur at 0.49/0.50, 1.49/1.50, 1.99/2.00. Budget-sensitive buyers can choose slightly below the threshold (e.g. 0.95–0.98 ct) with negligible visual difference after setting. 1 ct = 0.2 g = 100 points.
